topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 25 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 10 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 4 common project-authored base contract(s) (upgradeabilityproxy, proxy, swap). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
